component.name: AVD Client
component.summary: Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 client for the COSMIC™ desktop

description.p: Sign in with one or more work or school accounts, see the desktops your organization assigned to you, and connect to them. Connections use FreeRDP; settings per account and per desktop cover full screen, monitors, sound, microphone, clipboard and opening on a new workspace.
Unofficial community app. It is not a Microsoft product; for compatibility it signs in with Microsoft's public Remote Desktop client identity.
